propositions: Inbound Jira status writes bypass the parent-first cascade seam, allowing invalid states where a closed parent holds an active child
The operator ruled that the inbound-reconcile write surface must uphold the same parent-first invariant as the interactive cascade (operator ruling recorded verbatim)

A new helper _cascade_inbound_status_parents must mirror the interactive cascade at the inbound event-write surface by consulting _CASCADING_EDGES and _resolve_parent_in_status, then writing eligible ancestors' STATUS events first
Inbound status writes must suppress same-status no-ops to prevent cascaded parent mutations from fighting the parent's own inbound status mutation in the same batch
The cascade decision is single-sourced on the interactive machinery; the inbound path deliberately does NOT route through transition_compute to remain deterministic and avoid imposing the LLM gate
